title: x-regulation
description: A clause of legally binding law — a clause, article, or section of a law, regulation, or directive. Standards and control frameworks are x-control, not x-regulation. Defined by the CSA Security Controls Catalog.

regulation_namespace.description: Publishing jurisdiction namespace, mirroring the SecID namespace component (e.g. europa.eu, govinfo.gov, ca.gov).

regulation.description: Instrument name, mirroring the SecID name component (e.g. gdpr, ai-act, nis2, hipaa).

regulation_version.description: Optional, and often absent: many regulations are identified by publication reference rather than a version number. Where an instrument is amended, the date an amendment took effect is the practical discriminator.

clause_identifier.description: The clause, article, or section, mirroring the SecID subpath (e.g. art-32/1/a).

text_excerpt.description: Verbatim text of the clause. Licence-constrained: populate only where the source record permits reproduction, and omit it otherwise in favour of an original description. See CONVENTIONS-STIX-MODELING.md section 8.

object_marking_refs.description: Data markings applying to the whole object. Every catalog object carries TLP:WHITE, since the catalog is public. TLP:WHITE is the STIX 2.1 spelling of what TLP 2.0 renamed TLP:CLEAR; the identifier is assigned by the specification, and STIX forbids producers from defining their own tlp markings. Additional markings may be present.

newSdoExtension.description: Declares the object as a new SDO defined by a CSA extension-definition. The definition object must travel with the instance in any published bundle.
